chunks: Hudhayfa ibn al-Khuzā'ī, their client. He narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh and Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā (peace be upon them).
The sound and the unsound are narrated from him.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى: Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā (Imam al-Kāẓim, peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh (Imam al-Sādiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.مَوْلَاهُمْ: Their client (mawla, referring to the freed slave or client of the Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the status of Hudhayfa ibn al-Khuzai as a narrator in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry describes Ḥudhayfa ibn al-Khuzāʿī, a narrator from the Imams, noting that he transmitted both sound (ṣaḥīḥ) and unsound (saqīm) hadiths, indicating his reliability in transmission despite the mixed quality of his narrations.

en.tashayyu: 28 – Ḥudhayfa b. al-Khuzāʿī, their client.  Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh  عليه السلام and Abū alḤasan Mūsā  عليه السلام .
The sound and the unsound are narrated from him.
